title: pg_upgrade to PostgreSQL 18 stops with 'old cluster does not use data checksums but the new one does'
symptoms: old cluster does not use data checksums but the new one does
pg_upgrade --check fails right after initdb of the new 18 cluster
cause: initdb in PostgreSQL 18 enables data checksums by default, and pg_upgrade requires both clusters to match. Clusters created by earlier versions usually have checksums off.
fix: Initialize the new cluster with --no-data-checksums and upgrade. If you want checksums, enable them afterwards with pg_checksums while the server is stopped.
affected: PostgreSQL 18.0 and later (September 2025), upgrading from clusters without checksums
